items.title: Joe Wilder — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Harry James had a team. He was a baseball fanatic.

ctx.x: Did any of the bands you were with have baseball teams?

Basie had a baseball team. We used to play ball. Harry James had a team. He was a baseball fanatic. We used to play even in Les Hite’s band. We didn’t have an organized time. We liked to play ball, and sometimes you’d meet another band on the road, and they’d say, let’s have a scrub game. They’d have a baseball game. Cab [Calloway] had a pretty good team. He was a guy – he didn’t like to lose. So most of his guys gave up after a while, because if they lost, they were in trouble. But it was a lot of fun. I…
Oh, no, you had to watch it.
